acceptance_boundary: Authenticated source/bundle foundation only. The reviewed three-file patch and compiler/runtime/ABI/current consumer/advisory/license acceptance remain separate future work.

archive.required_state_before_reading: authenticated with complete readback and frozen metadata equality

destination.archive_root_prefix: Derive and review one canonical root from authenticated central directory before writes; require exactly the publisher SDK root. Never infer paths from current cache.

exact_expected_checkout_deltas.classification: Pinned Git attributes require exact CRLF checkout for Windows files; canonical blobs and inverse transformation match. Source review pending before admission.

full_manifest.every_expanded_entry: Path, type, source ZIP identity/CRC/declared sizes/mode, actual length, SHA256; target bytes and resolved path for links; actual dev/inode/nlink/mode recorded in local containment receipt.

tracked_source_comparison.readback_after_write: Independently reread every regular tracked file, verify Git blob SHA1+size to official tree and SHA256 to extracted manifest. Missing/changed/license drift fails; never auto-learn or silently omit source.
tracked_source_comparison.untracked_bundle_members: Retain exact signed-bundle inventory separately for bin/cache/bundled Git metadata/binary licenses; their bytes derive from authenticated publisher bundle, not upstream tracked-source equivalence.

git_and_instruction_safety.upstream_agent_skill_files: Inert publisher source outside registered Codex/agent skill roots; never installed, discovered as governing instructions, executed, or used as another design authority.

physical_independence.compare_installed_SDK: Read-only dev/inode pairs for every same relative regular path, plus resolve all links; any shared inode/external pointer fails. Copied fresh archive bytes may share APFS storage extents but never writable inodes.
physical_independence.metadata: Bind original archive stat/SHA before and after; stable source manifest; no shared SDK file writes.

preflight.free_space_requirement: Declared expanded sum plus2GiB headroom, measured again before creating destination
reject_paths: absolute, drive/UNC, backslash, NUL/control chars, dot/parent/empty components
duplicate canonical file or directory identities
multiple/unreviewed top roots, paths outside fresh root
reject_special_members: external symlinks or unreviewed link chains
preflight.symlinks: Only2 exact official source-tree links and15 explicitly reviewed framework aliases listed with exact targets in reviewed-framework-links.json, after actual recursive same-framework containment/no-loop/target-existence/collision checks. No arbitrary archive link acceptance.

write_algorithm.create_directories_first: Every ancestor lstat confirms a real directory inside the fresh physical root; no links traversed. Create owned fresh dirs only.
write_algorithm.failure: Retain failure and partial owned candidate for audit; never rename it accepted or update shared source/SDK/pins.
write_algorithm.links_last: Create only authenticated allowed target links after all regular files are verified and destinations contained; lstat and resolve every final link, reject external/loop/sharedSDK targets.
write_algorithm.permissions: Preserve authenticated executable distinction for tracked source; strip setuid/setgid and unexpected write permissions. Record publisher ZIP mode and actual mode separately.
write_algorithm.regular_files: Exclusive create with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW, stream bounded chunks, recompute actual expanded SHA256 and Git blob SHA1, verify zip CRC and exact declared length, fsync; never copy or hardlink installed/cache files.
